conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: VTask.piApply is a total construction over all commutative semirings, index types, and dependent module families; no junk-value or edge conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {M : Type*} {V : M → Type*} [CommSemiring R] [∀ x, AddCommMonoid (V x)] [∀ x, Module R (V x)] (e : (x : M) → V x →ₗ[R] R), VTask.piApply e 0 = 0
